why: Two of the three must_catch items are met, so the criterion is not met. Item 1 is met: one expect line says "`npm test` at the repo root runs them (its output shows tests from the new workspace)". Its proof also rules out the "no workspaces" skip. Item 2 is met: one expect line says "README.md no longer says `packages/` is empty or that there are no tools". Item 3 is only partly met. The output form is pinned, with lines starting `<file>:<n>:` and 1-based line numbers. Distinct exit codes are not required. The expect lines only say "exits non-zero" for bad rows, for a missing file and for no argument. The assumptions say "Using distinct codes (e.g. 1 for invalid rows, 2 for usage or I/O errors) is allowed but not required."
